facts.value: When selecting a partner university, please pay attention to the general language requirements mentioned here as well as the specific language requirements of the respective partner university in the various country categories.
The information regarding the TOEFL test refers to the internet-based test. Please note that a 'MyBest Scores' result is not accepted.

If you do not speak the local language of the host country, it is recommended that you acquire basic knowledge of the respective language as far as possible. However, this is not a prerequisite for application!
If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), these are to be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit evidence of one language proficiency.
